from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One company's financing cash flow from its 10-Q filing."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name this filing belongs to")
    cash_flow_amount: float = Field(description="The financing cash flow amount as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str = Field(description="Scale of the amount: 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions'")
    direction: str = Field(description="Whether cash flow is 'provided' or 'used'")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period for this financial data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flows: list[FinancingCashFlow]
